text: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: After 4-years' study, students will be elites in the petroleum field. Become a petroleum professional with extensive basic theoretical knowledge, solid practical application capabilities, who can engage in engineering design, reservoir engineering design, production and construction, site management, international cooperation, and scientific research in the field of petroleum engineering. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: The courses list below are mainly like by students. Oil and Gas Development Geology Reservoir Engineering Drilling Engineering Log Interpretation and Production Logging 3. Research areas Editor Notes: Two research areas are provided for students. Oil and Natural Gas Drilling, Developing, and Ocean Engineering 4. School Introduction Editor Notes: CUPB is in a leading position in the petroleum and petrochemical disciplines in China. China University of Petroleum, Beijing Campus (CUPB) , is located in a scenic region of tourist interest in Changping County, Beijing, about 5 miles to the Ming Tombs and 15 miles to the Great Wall. CUPB offers not only engineering programs in oil and gas science including chemical engineering, petroleum engineering, geoscience and mechanical and electronic engineering, but also, in computer science, business management and Chinese Language Study programs of a full range from diploma, bachelor's and master's to doctoral programs.
